questions.question: Walk me through how you would develop the one-line diagram and perform the initial load, demand, voltage-drop, and protective-device coordination considerations for a new industrial facility distribution system.
Please confirm whether you are legally authorized to work in the United States and, if applicable, whether you would now or in the future require employment sponsorship.

A contractor submits a control-panel shop drawing that does not clearly show short-circuit current rating, grounding, wire numbering, or spare capacity. How would you review it, document comments, and determine whether it can proceed?

A PLC-controlled process has intermittent false high-level alarms from a field sensor. Describe your troubleshooting sequence from the instrument through wiring, input card, PLC logic, HMI alarm configuration, and process conditions.

What experience, if any, do you have designing lighting for industrial or facility spaces? Explain how you would select fixture types, establish illumination targets, address emergency lighting, and coordinate the layout with the facility design.

For a three-phase motor-driven pump, explain how you would choose between across-the-line starting, a soft starter, and a variable-frequency drive, and how each choice affects protection, controls, and the electrical distribution system.

How would you specify control-panel segregation, grounding, shielding, power supplies, terminal blocks, labeling, and maintainability for a panel containing 480 V motor circuits alongside 24 VDC PLC and instrument circuits?

What calculations and design checks would you perform to size a facility transformer, switchboard, feeders, and panelboards when the load includes motors, nonlinear loads, future capacity, and standby-power requirements?

Describe the largest industrial electrical design scope you have personally owned. What facility-level deliverables did you produce, what codes or standards governed the work, and what were your design decisions?

Given a P&ID for a chemical dosing skid, explain how you would translate the process intent into an instrument index, I/O list, control narrative, loop diagrams, and electrical/control-panel interfaces.
